mapper.select: SELECT user_id,user_nm,dev_id,user_stts_cd,rsgn_dt,pswd_chg_need_yn='Y' AS restricted FROM sys.user_info WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT r.role_id FROM sys.user_role u JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND r.use_yn='Y' ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT p.bsn_part_id FROM sys.user_part u JOIN mst.bsn_part p ON p.bsn_part_id=u.bsn_part_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y'
SELECT p.prj_id FROM sys.user_prj u JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=u.prj_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND p.use_yn='Y'

WITH RECURSIVE active_menu AS ( SELECT menu_id,scrn_id FROM sys.menu WHERE upr_menu_id IS NULL AND use_yn='Y' UNION ALL SELECT m.menu_id,m.scrn_id FROM sys.menu m JOIN active_menu p ON p.menu_id=m.upr_menu_id WHERE m.use_yn='Y' ) SELECT r.role_id,r.role_nm,r.data_scope_cd,r.admin_yn='Y' AS admin,r.snstv_inq_yn='Y' AS sensitive, r.part_std_chg_auth_yn='Y' AS "partStandardChange",m.scrn_id, a.inq_auth_yn||a.reg_auth_yn||a.mdfcn_auth_yn||a.del_auth_yn||a.upld_auth_yn||a.dwnld_auth_yn||a.cnfrm_auth_yn AS actions, a.contact_inq_auth_yn='Y' AS "contactInquiry",a.contact_dwnld_auth_yn='Y' AS "contactDownload" FROM sys.user_role u JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=u.role_id AND r.use_yn='Y' JOIN sys.role_menu_auth a ON a.role_id=r.role_id JOIN active_menu m ON m.menu_id=a.menu_id WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND m.scrn_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT session_id_hash,user_id,created_at,last_activity_at,expires_at,revoked_at,password_change_only_yn='Y' AS restricted FROM sys.login_session WHERE session_id_hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.login_session(session_id_hash,user_id,created_at,last_activity_at,expires_at,password_change_only_yn) VALUES(#{hash},#{userId},#{now},#{now},#{expiresAt},CASE WHEN #{passwordChangeOnly} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE session_id_hash=#{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE sys.login_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys.login_session WHERE expires_at <= #{now} OR revoked_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT role_id FROM sys.role WHERE admin_yn='Y' ORDER BY role_id FOR UPDATE
SELECT count(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sys.user_info u JOIN sys.user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN sys.role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE r.admin_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.user_role(user_id,role_id) SELECT #{userId},role_id FROM sys.role WHERE role_nm='시스템 관리자' AND admin_yn='Y' AND use_yn='Y'
